name: Minami no Umi no Odyssey
source:
Main character is 6th grader in elementary school. He comes to Guam island with his twin brothers fleeing from the plague. The uninhabited island gets flooded with time, and there's no other option but to try to flee the island.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是小学六年级学生。他与双胞胎兄弟逃离瘟疫，来到关岛。无人岛逐渐被海水淹没，他们别无选择，只能设法逃离岛屿。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
